rows.note: Use 問 as the all-purpose verb for requesting information, putting a question to someone, or checking whether permission is given.

example.english: I want to ask whether you’re free tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我想問你聽日得唔得閒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4

rows.note: Use 要 when asking for an item or service, or when something is required or demanded, rather than when asking someone to perform an action.

example.english: I want to ask for a glass of iced lemon tea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

rows.note: Use 叫 when asking or telling someone to do something, especially in casual speech.

example.english: Can you ask him to take a photo for me?
example.traditional: 你可唔可以叫佢幫我影張相？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 giu3 keoi5 bong1 ngo5 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2

rows.note: Use 請 when asking someone to attend an event or inviting them somewhere.

example.english: I want to ask you to come to my birthday party.
example.traditional: 我想請你嚟我個生日會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 ceng2 nei5 lai4 ngo5 go3 saang1 jat6 wui2
